questions.question: Your agent gets 'connection refused' calling http://localhost:11434. What's the most likely cause?
options: The model's context window is full
The Ollama server isn't running
Your API key expired
The prompt is too long
questions.explanation: Port 11434 is the Ollama server. 'Connection refused' means nothing is listening, so start it with `ollama serve` or the desktop app.

questions.question: Do you need a model running to start Phase 1 of this course?
options: Yes, every lesson calls a hosted API
Yes, Ollama must be running for the tests
No. Lessons run offline against a scripted model; a real one is switched on with AGENT_BASE_URL and AGENT_MODEL
No, because lessons don't use models until Phase 9
questions.explanation: A scripted model replays fixed assistant messages, so code and tests are deterministic and free. A real model is optional per run.

questions.question: Why does agent-doctor drop models like nomic-embed-text when choosing one to ping?
options: They are too large
Embedding models turn text into vectors and can't hold a conversation
They require an API key
They only work in TypeScript
questions.explanation: Embedding models output vectors for search. Sending them a chat request fails or returns nothing useful.

questions.question: On the `start` route, Docker is missing. What does agent-doctor report?
options: A failure, because Phase 12 uses containers
Nothing: Docker isn't part of the `start` route, so it's neither checked nor allowed to block it
A failure, but only on macOS
It installs Docker automatically
questions.explanation: Each route checks only what it needs. Docker is in the `sandboxing` route, and even there it's a warning, because only 12.05's optional `--run` needs it.

questions.question: agent-doctor finds a `.env` file that `git ls-files` lists. Why is that a failure, and what's the complete fix?
options: It's only a style issue; rename the file
Git tracks it, so the keys in it get committed. Untrack it, ignore it, and rotate every key it contains
Delete the file; the keys are then safe
Move it into the code/ folder
questions.explanation: Once a key reaches a commit, clones, forks and caches may keep it. Removing the file isn't enough: rotate the keys.

questions.question: Your agent's loop seems to call the same tool forever with odd arguments. agent-doctor shows `[FAIL] Model ... doesn't serve 'gpt-5'` because AGENT_BASE_URL points at a local Ollama. What should you do first?
options: Add a step limit to the loop
Rewrite the tool's schema
Fix layer 3 first: set AGENT_MODEL to a model the server has, then see whether the loop problem remains
Switch to a framework
questions.explanation: Fix the stack bottom-up. A broken model layer shows up as strange agent behaviour; debugging the loop before fixing it wastes the hour this lesson saves.
